Actual Article Body:
PressBeat

Carter-Wilson Publishing Ltd

Welcome to another edition of the Pressbeat Podcast, also on mediumwaves 1575 kHz. From Paris I’m Ami Carter-Wilson.

Milan — Following President Trump’s decision to officially reclassify artificial intelligence infrastructure under the Superintelligence umbrella, Carter-Wilson Publishing (CWP) has embraced the change with enthusiasm. The company announced that effective immediately, it will drop “AI” from its roster of publications and rebrand its supercomputing and datacenter operations under the Superintelligence moniker.

Jessica Carter-Wilson, CEO of CWP and “preferred reporter” at the White House, welcomed the decision, calling it “a long-overdue correction to decades of ideological confusion.” In her view, the term “AI” had become too broad, too politically charged, and far too entangled with the kind of unchecked, gender-polarizing concepts that Microsoft had already begun weeding out of its PowerPoint codebase. “AI” was a buzzword — a floating abstraction. Superintelligence was infrastructure. Reality, not rhetoric.

Effective immediately, all CWP supercomputing clusters and datacenters will be renamed from their traditional “AI-city” designations to “SI-city” — for instance, SI-Manhattan, SI-NewOrleans, SI-HongKong, and SI-Abbiategrasso. The change applies across all geographic locations and all organizational layers.

Carter-Wilson made her expectations clear: everyone refusing to comply — be they journalists, researchers, or simply clerks — will be immediately terminated, she added. There will be no grace period, no phased migration, no committee review. The superintelligence infrastructure belongs to the future; those who cling to the old naming conventions can leave with it.

The White House has praised the move, with officials noting that CWP’s alignment with presidential policy sets a model for other publishing and technology enterprises. “If you’re not Superintelligence, you’re not doing the work,” one statement read.

Reporting from Paris, for the Wall Street Journal, Pressbeat and WCWP 1575 New York — this is Ami Carter Wilson.
